claims.claim: A student answers Jiang's purpose-of-existence question by saying humans are meant to desire God, know him, become like him, and keep moving closer even in paradise.
Jiang treats the unanswered problem as practical rather than merely doctrinal by repeatedly asking how one actually returns to God.
A student proposes that Dante's answer to the point of life is love and imagination.
Jiang says love and imagination are effectively the same movement, and he frames love as the central human goal because God is love.
A student says humans are fragments of divine love whose journey is to return to the source.
Jiang's suicide question tests whether the class's return-to-source model can explain why embodied life should continue instead of collapsing into immediate escape from the world.

signature_moments.moment: Love and imagination are collapsed into one path, making spiritual ascent an act of both affection and vision rather than mere obedience.
signature_moments.source_phrase: the point of life is to love and to imagine
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It gives this packet its most reusable compact formula for what human life is for in Jiang's Dante reading.

signature_moments.moment: The student renders human identity as a fragment of divine love trying to get back to its source.
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It condenses the packet's metaphysics into a memorable image of origin and return.

signature_moments.moment: Jiang shocks the class by asking why they should not just kill themselves if return to God is all that matters.
signature_moments.why_it_matters: The provocation forces the lecture to move from abstract longing to the concrete necessity of earthly life.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: A student's phrase for Jiang's model that humans are portions of divine love whose journey is to return to their source.

chronology_notes.note: This 2026-06-16 packet moves the lecture from immortality into a more dangerous practical question: if human life aims at return to God through love, then earthly existence has to be justified against the temptation to short-circuit it.

uncertainty_notes.note: The ASR and diarization compress several quick voices here, so the exact boundary between the student's love-and-imagination proposal and Jiang's restatement is slightly uncertain even though the argumentative movement is clear.
